m: परि-√ बाध् Ā. -बाधते, to ward or keep off, exclude from, protect or defend against (abl.), VS.; Br. &c. ; to vex, molest, annoy, MBh.; Kāv. : Desid. -बिबाधिषते, to strive to keep or ward off, ŚBr.
परि-बाध् f. hindrance or a hinderer, RV.
a: परिबाध् — {c1c} A. 1 To trouble, afflict; Ś. 7. 25. --2 Ved. To hinder, obstruct. --3 Ved. To protect from or defend against.

m: परि-बाधा f. trouble, toil, hardship, Śak.
a: परिबाधा — 1 Trouble, pain, annoyance. --2 Fatigue, hardship; Ś. 3. 22.

m: परि-बाध m. a noxious or troublesome demon, MantraBr.

a: परिबंध् — {c9c} A. 1 To tie, bind. --2 To put on. --3 To encircle, fasten round. --4 To arrest, stop. --5 To hinder, interrupt. --Caus. To tie round.

m: परि-बद्ध mfn. bound, stopped, obstructed, R.

परि-√ बन्ध् Ā. -बध्नीते (impf. 3. sg. पर्य्-अबन्धत, MBh.; Pass. पर्य्-अबध्यत, ib.; pf. Ā. परि-बेधिरे, AV.), to tie to, bind on, put on; to surround, encircle: Caus. -बन्धयति, to tie round, embrace, span, Cat.
परि-बन्धन n. tying round, L.
परि-बर्ह m. (ifc. f(आ). ) ‘surroundings’, retinue, train, furniture, attire, trim, property, wealth, the necessaries of life, MBh.; R. &c.
royal insignia, L.
a: परिब(व)र्हः — 1 Retinue, train, attendants; इयं प्रचुरपरिबर्हया भवत्या संवर्ध्यतां Dk. 108. --2 Furniture; परिवर्हवंति वेश्मानि R. 14. 15 ‘rooms properly furnished or provided with furniture’. --3 Royal insignia. --4 The necessaries of life. --5 Property, wealth.

k.v: परिच्छदे नृपार्हेऽर्थे परिबर्होऽव्ययाः परे। आङीषदर्थेऽभिव्याप्तौ सीमार्थे धातुयोगजे॥
परिच्छदे नृपार्हेऽर्थे परिबर्होऽव्ययाः परे। आङीषदर्थेऽभिव्याप्तौ सीमार्थे धातुयोगजे॥

m: परि-बर्हणा f. growth, increase, Nir., Sch.
परि-बर्हण n. retinue, train, attire, trim, MBh.
worship, adoration, BhP.
a: परिब(व)र्हणं — 1 Retinue, train. --2 Attire, trim. --3 Growth. --4 Worship.

m: परि-बर्ह—वत् mfn. (a house) provided with suitable furniture, Ragh.

परि-√ बृंह् (√ 2. बृंह्, also written वृंह् in verb forms and deriv.) P. Ā. -बृंहति (or -बृहति), ˚ते (p. pf. Ā. -बबृहाण, prob. solid, strong, RV. v, 41, 12), to embrace, encircle, fasten, make big or strong, Br. : Caus. -बृंहयति, to make strong, strengthen, MBh.
a: परिबृं(वृं)ह् — {c6c} U. 1 To strengthen, fortify. --2 To increase. --3 Ved. To encircle, surround.

m: परि-बृंहण n. prosperity, welfare, BhP.
an additional work, supplement, Mn.; MBh.
परि-बृंहित mfn. (or ˚वृहित; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 21, Sch.) increased, augmented, strengthened by, connected or furnished with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; BhP.
परि-बृंहित n. the roar of an elephant, L.
a: परिबृं(वृं)हित — p. p. 1 Increased, augmented. --2 Thriven, grown prosperous. --3 Accompanied by, furnished with. --तं The roar of an elephant.

m: परि-बृढ (परि-), mfn. firm, strong, solid, ŚBr.; Nir.
परि-बोध m. (√ बुध्) reason (-वत् mfn. endowed with reason, Śak. v, 21, v.l.)
परि-बोधनीय mfn. to be admonished, ib.
परि-बोधन n. exhortation, admonition (also f(आ). ), Kād.
परि-बोध—वत् mfn., endowed with reason, Śak. v, 21, v.l.
परि-√ ब्रू P. -ब्रवीति (Pot. -ब्रूयात्), to utter a spell or charm, lay under a spell, enchant, AV.; Kāṭh.
परि-बुभुक्षित mfn. (Desid. of परि- √ 3. भुज्), very hungry, MBh.
